dct_description_sm: Accompanied by a pamphlet entitled Map of the Railroads from Rome to Albany and Troy; with Explanatory Remarks and Sketches of the History, Geology and Present Condition of the Mohawk Valley. By Levi Williams, Civil Engineer. 1846.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Detailed map of the Mohawk Valley from Troy to Rome showing drainage, relief by hachures, towns, and villages.
dct_title_s: Map of the rail roads, from Rome to Albany and Troy, by one of the engineers who assisted in contructing, prepared from actual survey
